task_title: Enforce intra-family repo_url agreement and publish a public-safe rejection census + waiver
task_criteria: In a worktree at origin/main d107ac4: (1) scripts/lane_target.py repo-url --row enforces intra-family repo_url agreement: a primary+satellite fixture whose rows carry two different VALID git roots exits nonzero and names both lanes, while the aligned fixture exits 0; (2) a public-safe census artifact under docs/audits/ records live-export rejection totals by class plus the exact reproduction commands, with no lane names and no host paths, and a committed waiver file lists every remaining rejection class with a named owner and a re-check date; (3) tests/selftest.sh gains an arm that fails on the diverged fixture and passes on the aligned one, and reverting the divergence check makes that arm fail; (4) bash tests/selftest.sh prints SELFTEST: PASS and ruff check . plus ruff format --check . both exit 0.
